mapper.insert: INSERT INTO decision_feedback(decision_id, actual_alert, reviewer, remark, create_time, log_content, log_level, log_template, model_confidence, is_trained, error_rate_1m, error_1m, total_1m, interval_ms) VALUES(#{decisionId}, #{actualAlert}, #{reviewer}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{logContent}, #{logLevel}, #{logTemplate}, #{modelConfidence}, #{isTrained}, #{errorRate1m}, #{error1m}, #{total1m}, #{intervalMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_alert = VALUES(actual_alert), reviewer = VALUES(reviewer), remark = VALUES(remark), create_time = NOW(), log_content = VALUES(log_content), log_level = VALUES(log_level), log_template = VALUES(log_template), model_confidence = VALUES(model_confidence), is_trained = VALUES(is_trained), error_rate_1m = VALUES(error_rate_1m), error_1m = VALUES(error_1m), total_1m = VALUES(total_1m), interval_ms = VALUES(interval_ms)
mapper.select: SELECT id, decision_id, actual_alert, reviewer, remark, create_time, log_content, log_level, log_template, model_confidence, is_trained, error_rate_1m, error_1m, total_1m, interval_ms FROM decision_feedback WHERE is_trained = 0 OR is_trained IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
